description: Land Title Settlement Department - Naththandiya, Naththandiya D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410443 (23/0191)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and property descriptions. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcels, their owners, extent, title classifications, and encumbrances - all falling squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
